main_body: Orange autumn tree canopy of clustered leaf clumps on a brown trunk
top_band: Canopy clumps with lighter orange highlights on upper surfaces (rows ~1-12), rolling down into darker orange/red-brown undersides; trunk below rows 31-44
evidence: As an organic tree, the canopy is built from rounded clumps lit from above with light orange tops and darker lower edges, so the upper surfaces read as volumes seen from above. The dark red-brown underside of the canopy shades the trunk, which is a visible front face. There is no flat elevation, no isometric side face and no top-only plan. No hard front-edge line is drawn, which is normal for foliage.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 orange steps from highlight through mid tones to dark red-brown, with a few yellow highlight pixels, and the outline is a dark red-brown tinted to the foliage rather than black. The trunk has 3-4 browns with some grain, and the grass tufts are minimal. Clumps are shaded in stepped blocks, which is a little more blocky than the references' leaf-by-leaf dithering and fine texture. The canopy interiors are smoother and carry fewer per-leaf dots, so density is a bit below the reference. Still, it would sit acceptably next to the reference.
